title: Pastor Williams Onyeabor Mokwunye is a dedicated and humble leader in the Redeemed Christian Church of God, serving as a pastor in Enugu and Ebonyi States since 2000. Born 33 years ago in Delta State, he has a strong educational background in psychology and accounting, along with a Post-Graduate Diploma from the Redeemed Bible College. Mokwunye is known for his commitment to security, having founded an Anti-cult squad during his time at the Institute of Management and Technology (IMT) to combat cultism. His leadership has led to significant reductions in cult-related incidents, earning him various awards, including recognition from the National Drug Law and Enforcement Agency. He actively participates in security-related initiatives and is a patron of the Drug Free Club at IMT. Mokwunye is married and has a son, and his contributions to community safety and leadership have been widely acknowledged.
